Here are the descriptions of the line plots, following your guidelines:

The plots illustrate the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy percentage for different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 10<sup>0</sup> to 10<sup>3</sup>, with tick labels at intervals of 10<sup>1</sup>. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and has a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. 

The first line, representing “Base”, is black with circular markers and a solid line style. It begins at approximately (10<sup>0</sup>, 72) and increases to approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 77). The second line, representing “FT”, is blue with triangular markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately (10<sup>0</sup>, 68) and ending at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 76). The third line, representing “IKE”, is red with diamond markers and a solid line style, beginning at approximately (10<sup>0</sup>, 66) and ending at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 74). The fourth line, representing “MEMIT”, is magenta with square markers and a solid line style, starting at approximately (10<sup>0</sup>, 70) and ending at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 78). The fifth line, representing “ROME”, is green with star markers and a solid line style, beginning at approximately (10<sup>0</sup>, 75) and ending at approximately (10<sup>3</sup>, 80).
